title: Charging Ahead—VOOL’s Path to Scalable, High-Impact EV Charging Solutions
seoTitle: Charging Ahead—VOOL’s Path to Scalable, High-Impact EV Charging Solutions
body:
The Future of EV Charging is ELECTRIFYING!

This isn’t just a bold statement—it’s happening right now. More people are switching to EVs, climate goals are tightening, and the demand for convenient, affordable charging is skyrocketing. By 2030, the world will need around 35 million chargers—a number that underscores the urgency of expanding charging infrastructure. With governments backing the transition and the market fully embracing greener mobility, the shift has started.


Today, home charging dominates the EV landscape, accounting for nearly 80% of all charging sessions. It’s the most convenient and cost-effective option for most drivers. Workplaces make up another 15%, offering employees an easy way to top up their batteries—especially those without access to home charging. Meanwhile, public charging, though just 5% of the total, remains essential for road trips and urban mobility.

For multi-dwelling units (MDUs)—apartment complexes and shared buildings, where 60% of home charging takes place—tailored solutions are needed. Challenges like load balancing, shared billing, and infrastructure upgrades require smart innovations to ensure seamless and fair access for all residents.

Shifting Focus to Larger Installations.

VOOL is doubling down on workplaces and large-scale multi-residential projects. Why? Bigger impact, smarter growth, and streamlined execution. One installation can power hundreds of EVs, maximizing sustainability and efficiency. Meeting the rising demand from fleets, logistics hubs, and property developers keeps VOOL ahead in the expanding e-mobility market. And by focusing on larger projects, VOOL simplifies operations, strengthens partnerships, and drives long-term success.

IMAGE BELOW: What if old infrastructure could power the future? That’s exactly what Pay N Charge Nordic has done in Sweden using VOOL’s technology!

Product Design and Development: Adapting for Scalability.

Our hardware and software are designed for high-volume installations, starting with a modular, future-ready charging solution for larger apartment complexes. With the new VOOL charger case, property owners, apartment unions, and developers can have casing and wiring pre-installed, enabling end-users to integrate the controller module later with minimal effort. It’s an affordable and smart way to prepare for EV charging. Install the casing and blind front cover today, and when the user is ready, upgrade effortlessly with the VOOL controller. No extra wiring, no hassle—just instant power.

We’ve also integrated smart load management solutions, such as dynamic load balancing, to keep chargers running efficiently without overloading the grid. Additionally, our end-to-end integration seamlessly manages billing and user authentication, making it an ideal solution for large-scale sites. Offices and other installations can also offer public charging, providing additional convenience and accessibility for EV drivers.

IMAGE BELOW: Our Lithuanian partner, Energway, has installed over 45 VOOL chargers at Thermo Fisher Scientific Baltics, which is looking to the future by modernizing its parking areas to support the EV revolution.

Growth Ahead!

The AC charger market is crowded, but we’re taking a different route. While most brands cater to individual EV owners, VOOL is building scalable, future-proof solutions for large sites that need reliable, future-proof solutions.

The EV charging industry is set to grow fivefold by 2030, and the biggest opportunities lie in workplaces and multi-unit residences. That’s where seamless, scalable solutions matter most—and where VOOL is leading the charge.

Join Us on Our Journey.

At VOOL, we want to make EV-charging accessible for everyone —and we invite you to join us. Whether you’re a property owner, developer, or partner looking to revolutionize EV infrastructure, we’re ready to collaborate. Let’s work together to drive innovation and build a smarter, more efficient charging ecosystem. Get in touch today and be part of the future of smart charging! 🚀
